metadata.purpose: Phase 26 regression baseline — Plan 04 asserts that calibrated 2D defaults reproduce these within tolerance_rel at biases <= -10 V

Lower N_D_bulk -> wider depletion at 10 V. tolerance_rel kept at 0.1%.
metadata.rebaselined_plan_26_04: cce_center_*um updated from 0.96446952 (v3.0 snapshot) to 0.96085509 (calibrated graded defaults). The 0.37% shift is the intended consequence of the -50V convergence calibration (CONS-01 SC#1); N_D_bulk 8.5e13->8.823e13 dominates. tolerance_rel kept at 0.1% as a forward guard.
metadata.rebaselined_default_cleanup: 2026-10-17: cce_center_*um 0.98552834 -> 0.95346904 (-3.25 %). The 2D builder defaults are now the full default stack (DEFAULT_STACK = DeviceConfig(): p+ 0.3 um, graded 2.974271e15 / 6.335936e13 / 0.987 um, n+ 1 um 1e19); the previous value froze a mix that was neither DeviceConfig() nor legacy_config() (builder geometry p+ 1 um / no n+ with the new doping). The 2D entries are therefore a guard of the default model at 10 V (just below its 10.3 V reach-through). cv_1d is unchanged: that test now pins the v3 geometry (p+ 1 um, no n+) explicitly with the v3 doping.
metadata.note_cv_observable_2026_10_17: Not re-baselined: after the small-signal-C recalibration (N_D_bulk 6.335936e13 -> 8.252732e13) and the hole mobility at the epi doping, cce_center (hw 50) = 0.95375989 vs frozen 0.95346904 (+0.03 %, inside tolerance_rel). The default model's reach-through is now 12.3 V (analytic 1.2 V_fd 11.92 V), so 10 V is BELOW full depletion, not 'just below' it as the rebaselined_default_cleanup note says.
